author: Ogrey
body:
And last but not least, after Slicorn's earlier promotion, we have also decided to promote Zedther along with him to the Map Developer gang. He has shown a lot of potential and I'm sure he'll help the team improve. Give him a warm welcome!

Congratulations, m8!
